'''Alpha-2 Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of Alpha-2 Squad were sent to an unknown [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Energy Vampire|energy vampire]], [[Countess/Legends|Countess]] [[Rajine]], only to later be used as [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]] servants. They were released from their undead fate by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who defeated Rajine.
